offer.text: Everybody who works with us gets a line in the ledger, and everybody's first line is paper. Twenty-four sheets and four bound books, and I will write your name at the top of a page.

accept.text: Your name, in ink, in a book that outlives us both.

in_progress.text: Paper, then books. The order matters to nobody but me.

ready.text: Bound properly, too. You have done this before.

complete.text: There. You are in the ledger. Everything after this is arithmetic.
